front: Cell symbol: which line is positive?
back: The long thin line is positive; the short thick line is negative.
A circle with a cross inside.
Thermistor: resistance falls as temperature rises. LDR: resistance falls as light increases.
Its thin wire melts and breaks the circuit if the current is too large.
Conduct in one direction only (forward bias); an LED needs a series resistor to limit the current.
Only in a complete circuit: an unbroken loop from one terminal of the source back to the other.
